result.stdout:
dwg-mcp - MCP stdio gateway for Autodesk AutoCAD 2022-2027.

Usage: dwg-mcp [options]

Options:
  --target <selector>    AutoCAD year (2022-2027), pid:<PID> or id:acad-<year>-<PID>.
                         Verify with dwg_switch_target before writes.
  --toolsets <csv>       Toolsets to register (default: query,modify,meta,view).
                         'all' enables the full surface.
  --read-only            Strip every write/execute tool, including dwg_switch_target.
                         Select reads at startup with --target pid:<PID> or id:<target_id>.
                         On target loss, list targets and restart with the intended selector.
  --enable-send-code / --disable-send-code (default: enabled).
  --enable-call-log / --disable-call-log (default: disabled).
  --enable-toolbaker / --disable-toolbaker
  --response-budget-bytes <n>       Final MCP tool-result budget (default: 83886080).
  --response-warn-bytes <n>         Warning threshold (default: 1048576, capped by budget).
  --response-strong-warn-bytes <n>  Strong warning threshold (default: 8388608, capped by budget).
                         ASCII decimal bytes; budget >= 4096 and 0 < warn <= strong <= budget.
                         Per tool result, excluding the JSON-RPC envelope; no automatic retry.
  --allow-lan-bind       Parsed but not yet implemented (loopback only).
  --log-level <level>    trace|debug|information|warning|error.
  --config <path>        JSON config file. Default:
                         %LOCALAPPDATA%\Bimwright\dwg-mcp\dwgmcp.config.json

Environment overrides: BIMWRIGHT_DWG_TARGET, BIMWRIGHT_DWG_TOOLSETS,
BIMWRIGHT_DWG_READ_ONLY, BIMWRIGHT_DWG_ENABLE_TOOLBAKER,
BIMWRIGHT_DWG_ENABLE_SEND_CODE, BIMWRIGHT_DWG_ENABLE_CALL_LOG,
BIMWRIGHT_DWG_ALLOW_LAN_BIND, BIMWRIGHT_DWG_LOG_LEVEL,
BIMWRIGHT_DWG_RESPONSE_BUDGET_BYTES, BIMWRIGHT_DWG_RESPONSE_WARN_BYTES,
BIMWRIGHT_DWG_RESPONSE_STRONG_WARN_BYTES.

  -h, --help             Show this help and exit.
